decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - Subject to the appropriate safeguarding conditions, it is considered that the proposed change of use would not harm the living conditions of nearby residents and would not harm the architectural or historic interest of the listed building. The proposal is therefore acceptable and would accord with ENV-B.1.1 (New development), ENV-B.2.7 (Alterations to listed buildings and buildings of local townscape character) and E.1.2 (Locations for business (B1) use).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall be operated only by a person resident at Stable Cottage, High Street Cranford, and one further person only shall be employed on the premises and the use shall be for the purposes of a Solicitor's office only and for no other use, including any use within Classes B1 and A2 of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987
description: Change of use of detached stable block to office and insertion of one internal wall to create a garage
